Affiliate benefits Earn Recurring Revenue Get paid with a recurring commission every time your referred clients consume data through Explorium’s API. Documentation New Business Opportunities We refer clients who need implementation support to our affiliate partners—grow your client base with high-quality leads. Join now Become an Certified partner Stand out with Explorium’s official certification badge—perfect for showcasing on your website, LinkedIn®, or sales materials. Join now Who We’re Looking For Freelancers & Independent Builders Data engineers, automation experts, and freelance developers creating enrichment layers, custom data pipelines, or GTM tools using third-party data and APIs. Agencies Automation and marketing agencies that build scalable data solutions, delivering enrichment, scoring, or segmentation to clients via bulk uploads or API-based workflows. Content Creators Bloggers, YouTubers, newsletter writers, and course creators covering data products, B2B tech stacks, APIs, or automation tools—with an audience hungry for what Explorium offers. Industry Leaders Thought leaders, product evangelists, and community builders driving discussions around B2B growth, data infrastructure, or modern marketing/sales ops—whether through social, podcasts, or events. Become an Affiliate Submit your details and our team will get in touch with more information and a customized offer tailored to your business. How much commission will I earn? You will earn 30% of the customer’s bill for the first 12 months of the customer’s lifecycle. No cap. Is there a cap on the number of referrals I can make? There is no cap on the number of referrals. However, your commission is capped for their first 12 months. When is commission paid? Commissions are paid on a Net 30 basis from the day of collection from the referred customer. How do I get paid? / What are the available payment methods? We can pay your commission via either Stripe, wire or Explorium Credits. Is there a minimum payout threshold? Yes. You will be eligible for payout only after earning at least $100 in commission. Can I get my commissions paid in RMB? No. Commissions are only paid in USD. Can you pay my commission in ways other than what PartnerStack offers? No. We only use PartnerStack’s available payment methods, and only in USD. Can you give me information about the identity of my referrals? No. Due to privacy reasons, we do not provide any information about referred customers. How do I keep track of my earnings from specific referred customers? Contact your affiliate manager or our affiliate team at [email protected] . Do you cover processing fees? No. Explorium does not cover processing fees. Who should I contact regarding technical issues with my affiliate account? Contact your affiliate manager or our affiliate team at [email protected] . jobs.title: Don’t Sell or Share My Personal Information
jobs.description: DO NOT SELL OR SHARE MY PERSONAL INFORMATION - Explorium Product AgentSource® MCP Server API Documentation Data Our Data Data Affiliation Use Cases Sales GTM Engineering Marketing Recruiting Integrations Pricing Company About Explorium Resource Center Blog Careers Contact Us Get a Demo | Login Sign Up Do not sell my personal information and right to be forgotten If you are a resident of California, Colorado, Virginia, and Connecticut your state’s privacy law provides you with the right to opt-out of the “sale” of your personal information. If you are a resident of the European Economic Area, you have various rights regarding your personal data, including the “right to be forgotten” (right to deletion). Explorium is an external data platform providing data services to its customers about businesses and professionals that are of interest to its customers (“Enrichment Data”). While the majority of the data we process is business related and publicly available, we understand that in some jurisdictions this data may be deemed personal information. We use Enrichment Data solely to fulfil our obligations pursuant to the commercial agreements we have with our customers, and upon a customer’s direct instructions. While we do not view this enrichment process as selling data, state privacy laws in the United States broaden the terms “sale”, and this process may be considered as a “sale” under state privacy law. If you reside in the European Economic Area, you have the ‘Right to be Forgotten’ which means you the right to ask us to erase your personal information that we use as Enrichment Data. If you wish to opt-out of this enrichment of your data for our customers, please submit an opt-out request using the form below. The form seeks the information we need to properly identify your information in our records and properly handle your request. We invite you to review our Website Privacy Policy and Platform & Services Privacy Policy for a more detailed description of how we collect, use, and share personal information in operating our business, your privacy rights and how to exercise your rights. Please note: Customer End User Data is the data that a customer provides to us. Platform & Services Usage Data is information that we collect about the representatives of the customer when they use our services. We never provide Customer End User Data or Platform & Services Usage Data (as defined in our Privacy Policy ) onward to be used by a third party. Your submission of the form below does not affect other instances of us sharing your information that are not considered “sale”, are not subject to your “Right to be Forgotten” or that fall within exemptions privacy and data protection laws. If you are located in the United States, your submission of the form below does not affect the enrichment of your data with data about you that is not considered personal information under state privacy law. If would like to request to exercise any other right you have as a data subject under privacy and data protection laws, such as the right to access and receive a copy of your personal information that we process, correct your information, please contact us at [email protected] Privacy Request Form Once you submit your request, we will review and process it as quickly as possible; however we may need to obtain additional information from you in order to validate and process your request. Once we have determined that the request is valid and have obtained the information we need to process the request, we will process the request within the time period required by applicable law. If we are unable to process your request, we will notify you using your preferred method of contact. Before You Begin Available Use Cases Recommended Workflow Best Practices for Using the API Next Steps You can reach us through the following channels: Email Support: support@explorium.ai Slack Channel: If you have a dedicated Slack channel with us, you can post your question there. ​ How to Leverage Explorium’s API ​ Overview Explorium’s Partner Service API provides powerful capabilities to enhance data-driven decision-making. Whether you’re in sales, marketing, risk assessment, or investment research, these Use Cases will guide you in leveraging our API effectively. Our use cases demonstrate how to streamline workflows, enrich data, and maximize business intelligence through our powerful API endpoints. ​ Why Use These Workflows? Boost Efficiency: Automate prospecting, lead enrichment, and business research. Improve Data Accuracy: Access real-time and enriched data from multiple sources. Enhance Targeting: Use granular filters to refine searches for businesses and individuals. Optimize Your Pipeline: Focus only on high-potential leads with verified contact information. Reduce Manual Work: Eliminate the need for manual research with automated data retrieval. ​ Before You Begin 1 Obtain Your API KeyYou’ll need a valid API key for all endpoints. For instructions on how to register and obtain credentials, see our Authentication Guide . Authentication Guide 2 Understand the Filters and Parameters Filters : values objects to include or exclude certain attributes (see List of Business Filters and List of Prospect Filters ). Pagination : You can specify page and page_size (up to 100 records per page). ​ Available Use Cases The following workflows illustrate different ways to leverage Explorium’s API. Click on any use case to explore the step-by-step guide. Sales & Marketing Workflows Prospecting & Lead Enrichment and reach out to ideal prospects with verified contact details. ​ Recommended Workflow To maximize efficiency and ensure precise targeting, follow this structured flow when working with Explorium’s API: Assess Market Potential – Use the stats endpoint to gauge the size and scope of your target audience before making large-scale data fetches. Match Businesses – Use the match endpoint to find the most accurate business_id for the companies you are targeting. Extract business_id to ensure precise data retrieval in the next steps. Fetch Business Data – Retrieve company records that match your desired filters (e.g., industry, company size, location) using the matched business_id . Match Prospects – Use the match endpoint to find the most accurate prospect_id for relevant employees within the selected businesses. Extract prospect_id to proceed with enrichment. Fetch & Enrich Prospects – Retrieve prospects using the matched prospect_id , then enrich them with verified contact details such as email addresses and phone numbers for effective outreach. Refine & Iterate – Adjust filters based on initial results to optimize for precision and efficiency. By first matching businesses and prospects using the match endpoints, you ensure that the data retrieved is highly accurate and relevant. Extracting business_id and prospect_id at the right stages allows for better enrichment and precise targeting, minimizing redundant API calls and maximizing efficiency. ​ Best Practices for Using the API Optimize API Calls: Use the stats endpoint before fetching full datasets to avoid unnecessary calls. Refine Filters: Use multiple filtering layers to get precise results without retrieving excessive data. Paginate Large Datasets: Break down requests into pages to manage data flow efficiently. Monitor Rate Limits: Ensure compliance with API rate limits to maintain performance and avoid throttling. We support up to 200 qpm . ​ Next Steps Get Started : Choose a use case and explore the detailed step-by-step guide. Read the Docs : Visit our API’s Documentation section for technical references.
